quizGuardRationale: Each direct declaration is an author hypothesis for independent review. Symmetric and nontransitive, never an inherited clique. Actual secondary meanings matter even when an older article teaches only its primary sense.

ハンドル/柄 uses the actualえhandle identity. 日当たり compares sunlight/exposure with日光/日差し without claiming exposure equals light in every construction. 日陰 compares shade/shadow with陰/影; its restricted sunlight sense does not create a sunlight guard.
日帰り compares travel/roundtrip/day-outing facets without saying all travel is same-day. 比較的 is not automatically a synonym of slightly, rather, or a strong degree adverb.

引き受ける compares responsible accepting, humble undertaking, being in charge, guaranteeing, inheritance and bearing responsibility. Merely receiving something and entrusting it are distinguished; acceptance-related edges need review for excess as well as omissions.

引き返す compares actual return/backward movement, not everyday transitive返す/帰す or historical繰り返す. 引き算 compares actual subtraction, deduction and computation, not other operations or tools by category alone.

引き出す retains direct出す and下ろす/降ろす withdrawal guards and adds引き出し for the actual financial transaction noun. Complete1601660:3 and1601650:2 plus both bodies support it; grammatical nominalization alone is not an exemption. Existing取り出す/抜く declarations protect only their own direct pairs.

引き止める compares actual stopping/detaining/restraining/hindering facets. 卑怯 compares cowardly/unfair/mean/sneaky facets without equating all fear or secrecy with dishonesty. 引き分け compares actual分ける tie5, not equality words or English necktie.

日差し compares actual sunlight and rays with日光/光/光線/日, not the celestial object太陽. ピストル compares銃/鉄砲 firearm facets, not every weapon. 肘 andビタミン do not inherit neighboring-body-part/nutrient/medicine guards by category.

ぴったり retainsちょうど/まさに and adds direct precision, fit, resemblance, close contact and abrupt complete-stop comparisons. 合う1284430 andしっかり1594400 were additionally inspected in full; generic degree or shared scene alone would not establish a guard.
引っ掛かる compares caught/snagged, stopby, broader掛かる and lingering concern facets; transitiveはめる/だます are not automatic subject-caught guards. Splash uses do not license transitive instructions.
No global uniqueness, universal substitutability, compiler-intent or model-bias-reduction claim follows from these declarations. Existing batch61 inherited debt remains deferred.
